name: Androstatis
description: All Bakugan defeated on this turn are revived at the start of the next turn.

name: Aqua Merge
description: All non-Subterra Bakugan on the field have their attribute changed to Aquos.

name: Aquos Hazard
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Aquos.

name: Battle Sham
description: If only two allied Bakugan are standing on this Gate Card, the highest G-powered allied Bakugan on it attacks a random opposing Bakugan. (bypasses stacks)

name: Darkus Hazard
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Darkus.

name: Doom Card
description: While this Gate Card is open, Doom Ability Cards are enabled; Bakugan defeated after the activation of this Gate Card cannot be revived.

name: Final Judgement
description: If the opponent's Bakugan's attribute is not equivalent to that of the owner, their G's become 0 G's immediately.

name: Gate Card Close
description: All Bakugan on the field are returned to hand.

name: Grand Spirit
description: Your Bakugan gain +50 G's for each Gate Card on the field.

name: Haos Hazard
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Haos.

name: Hyper Merge
description: Transfer 100 G's to each of your team's Bakugan from the opponent's Bakugan.

name: Intercept
description: The owner of this Gate Card immediately adds one Bakugan to it.

name: Joker's Wild
description: Darkus Bakugan win unconditionally.

name: Level Down
description: All Bakugan with 400 or more G's on this Gate Card lose 100 G's.

name: Magma Fuse
description: After this battle, all Gate Cards on the field are destroyed.

name: Mine Ghost
description: When at least two Bakugan are present on this Gate Card, all Bakugan on this Gate Card are defeated.

name: Negative Delta
description: If the opponent's Bakugan is Darkus, Subterra, or Ventus, it loses 200 G's. Otherwise, the user's Bakugan loses 200 G's.

name: Peacemaker
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are returned to their owners' hands.

name: Positive Delta
description: If the opponent's Bakugan is Pyrus, Aquos, or Haos, it loses 200 G's. Otherwise, the user's Bakugan loses 200 G's.

name: Pyrus Hazard
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Pyrus.

name: Quartet Battle
description: Both teams add Bakugan to the Gate Card until four or more are standing on it.

name: Quicksand Freeze
description: The winner of the battle stays on the Gate Card and has their G's lowered to 0 G's.

name: Reinforcement
description: Your Bakugan gains +100 G's for each Bakugan with the same attribute in play.

name: Reloaded
description: Your Bakugan gains +100 G's per each of your Bakugan on the battle field.

name: Revive
description: Winner of the battle on this Gate Card has their Bakugan revived.

name: Subterra Hazard
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Subterra.

name: Supernova
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card have their power level swapped.

name: Switchback
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to their original attribute.

name: Trade Off
description: Either side with a combined power level of over 400 G's is defeated.

name: Transformation
description: Your Bakugan's G-Power becomes equal to that of the strongest undefeated Bakugan you have in your hand.

name: Ventus Hazard
description: All Bakugan on the Gate Card are changed to Ventus.

name: Wall Lock
description: Return all Bakugan on this Gate Card to their base G's and negate all Ability Card effects before this Gate Card in a chain.

name: Ability Counter
description: Negate the last Ability Card if it targets your Haos Bakugan, is activated in battle involving your Haos Bakugan, or alters the Gate Card it is standing on.

name: Air Battle
description: Move your Ventus Bakugan to another Gate Card, prevent that Gate Card from opening while it remains on it.

name: Aqua Bubble
description: Your Aquos Bakugan prevents a Bakugan from being moved off the Gate Card it is currently on.

name: Aqua Guardian
description: Negate the last Ability Card if it targets your Aquos Bakugan, is activated in battle involving your Aquos Bakugan, or alters the Gate Card it is standing on.

name: Aquos Triple Chain: Tsunami Wave
description: If you control three Aquos Bakugan on the field, then choose one Aquos Bakugan you control and it defeats all Bakugan on the field excluding opposing Bakugan in battle with it.

name: Aquatic Refuge
description: Your Aquos Bakugan submerges under its current Gate Card, then for two of your turns, it cannot battle or be moved while submerged.

name: Back Draft
description: Your Ventus Bakugan returns a Bakugan to its owner's hand.

name: Backfire
description: Nullify the Gate Card your Pyrus Bakugan is on, then it gains +75 G's.

name: Black Is Darkness
description: Pull all adjacent opposing Bakugan to your Darkus Bakugan's Gate Card.

name: Blow Away
description: Your Ventus Bakugan moves an opposing Bakugan to another Gate Card.

name: Burning Soul
description: Your Pyrus Bakugan gains +100 G's for each Bakugan on its Gate Card. If it is on an opposing Gate Card, it instead gains +125 G's for each Bakugan on its Gate Card.

name: Copy Cat
description: Your Subterra Bakugan copies the last activated Ability Card.

name: Correlation: Aquos & Ventus
description: If there is a Ventus Bakugan on your Aquos Bakugan's Gate Card, your Aquos Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Correlation: Darkus & Aquos
description: If there is an Aquos Bakugan on your Darkus Bakugan's Gate Card, your Darkus Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Correlation: Haos & Darkus
description: If there is a Darkus Bakugan on your Haos Bakugan's Gate Card, your Haos Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Correlation: Pyrus & Subterra
description: If there is a Subterra Bakugan on your Pyrus Bakugan's Gate Card, your Pyrus Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Correlation: Subterra & Haos
description: If there is a Haos Bakugan on your Subterra Bakugan's Gate Card, your Subterra Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Correlation: Ventus & Pyrus
description: If there is a Pyrus Bakugan on your Ventus Bakugan's Gate Card, your Ventus Bakugan gains +100 G's. If the other Bakugan was an ally, both Bakugan gain +50 G's instead. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Darkus Gravity
description: Your Darkus Bakugan moves to an adjacent Darkus Bakugan's Gate Card.

name: Darkus Triple Chain: Deadly Nightshade
description: If you control three Darkus Bakugan on the field, each of your Darkus Bakugan transfer 75 G's from each adjacent Bakugan.

name: Destroy Force Down
description: Your Darkus Bakugan subtracts -40 G's from each Bakugan not controlled by you.

name: Diagonal Link: Aquos & Subterra
description: If there is a Subterra Bakugan on your Aquos Bakugan's Gate Card, your Aquos Bakugan gains +100 G's. You may also double select your Bakugan to throw in an allied Subterra Bakugan from hand and then gain +100 G's. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Diagonal Link: Haos & Ventus
description: If there is a Ventus Bakugan on your Haos Bakugan's Gate Card, your Haos Bakugan gains +100 G's. You may also double select your Bakugan to throw in an allied Ventus Bakugan from hand and then gain +100 G's. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Diagonal Link: Pyrus & Darkus
description: If there is a Darkus Bakugan on your Pyrus Bakugan's Gate Card, your Pyrus Bakugan gains +100 G's. You may also double select your Bakugan to throw in an allied Darkus Bakugan from hand and then gain +100 G's. (Vice Versa applies)

name: Dimension Four
description: Your Darkus Bakugan subtracts 2/4 of the G's from an opposing Bakugan it is battling if it is on an Attribute Gate Card, otherwise subtract 1/4 of its G's.

name: Dive Mirage
description: Your Aquos Bakugan moves to another Gate Card, if that Gate Card belongs to an opponent, nullify it.

name: Doom Companion
description: If the Doom Card is open, then your Darkus Bakugan defeats all Bakugan on its Gate Card, including itself.

name: Double Dimension
description: Negate the last Ability Card if it targets your Darkus Bakugan, is activated in battle involving your Darkus Bakugan, or alters the Gate Card it is standing on.

name: Earth Power
description: Add +50 G's to your Subterra Bakugan.

name: Enhancement
description: Your Haos Bakugan adds +100 G's to an allied Bakugan or adds +50 G's to itself.

name: Fire Judge
description: Your Pyrus Bakugan gains +100 G's.

name: Fire Tornado
description: Transfer 100 G's from an opposing Bakugan in battle with your Pyrus Bakugan.

name: Fire Wall
description: While on the Gate Card, your Pyrus Bakugan subtracts 50 G's from each opposing Bakugan.

name: Gate Building
description: Your Subterra Bakugan lets you draw a Gate Card and set it.

name: Grand Down
description: Nullify the Gate Card your Darkus Bakugan is on.

name: Grand Slide
description: Slide a Gate Card on the field to an empty space adjacent to your Subterra Bakugan, then move your Subterra Bakugan onto that Gate Card.

name: Grounded Infection
description: If the Gate Card your Subterra Bakugan is standing on is nullified, transfer that nullification to an adjacent Gate Card, then reactivate the Gate Card your Subterra Bakugan is standing on.

name: Haos Freeze
description: Immediately add an additional Haos Bakugan from your hand into a battle, if the Bakugan is a teammate's, it can be any attribute.

name: Haos Triple Chain: Haos Stasis
description: If you control three Haos Bakugan on the field, select one Haos Bakugan you control. It gains +100 G's, then recover 1 used Ability Card, then you and all teammates each draw 1 Ability Card.

name: Holograph Divide
description: Add +50 G's to your Aquos Bakugan, then add +50 G's to it at the end of your team's turns.

name: Jump Over
description: Your Ventus Bakugan moves to an adjacent Gate Card.

name: Lightning Shield
description: Nullify the Gate Card your Haos Bakugan is on, if you select an allied Bakugan that is not Haos, nullify the Attribute Gate Card it is on.

name: Lightning Tornado
description: Transfer 100 G's from an opposing Bakugan in battle with your Haos Bakugan.

name: Magma Prominence
description: Change the open Gate Card your Subterra Bakugan is standing on; if it is an Attribute Gate Card, change its Attribute to Subterra, otherwise change it into a Subterra 50 Gate Card.

name: Oregano Revenge
description: Your Darkus Bakugan subtracts -100 G's from each opposing Bakugan it is battling, you gain +100 G's, and each allied Bakugan on the Gate Card gains +100 G's if matched by an opposing Bakugan in the battle.

name: Power Charge
description: Your Pyrus Bakugan gains +100 G's, starting after two turns, unless it is defeated or returned to hand, it may attack an opposing Bakugan.

name: Pure Light
description: Your Haos Bakugan revives any defeated Bakugan, returning it to your hand or a teammate's.

name: Pyrus Triple Chain: Inferno Trinity
description: If you control three Pyrus Bakugan on the field, all your Pyrus Bakugan gain +100 G's for each opposing Bakugan on the field, then all your Pyrus Bakugan permanently gain +50 G's.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Add an additional Pyrus Bakugan in your hand into battle; if the Bakugan is a teammate's, it can be any attribute

name: Rapid Haos
description: Add an additional Haos Bakugan in your hand into battle; if the Bakugan is a teammate's, it can be any attribute

name: Reverse Blow
description: Return your Ventus Bakugan to your hand.

name: Sand Trap
description: Your Subterra Bakugan attacks an adjacent opponent's Bakugan, if it is not defeated, it loses -50 G's and a battle begins.

name: Scarlet Twister
description: Your Ventus Bakugan moves a Bakugan to another Gate Card, if that Bakugan was in a battle, your Ventus Bakugan is defeated.

name: Seismic Trigger
description: Your Subterra Bakugan targets another Bakugan that is standing on a Gate Card, then that Bakugan force-activates the Gate Card is standing on. (Caster may target themselves if the Chain is active)

name: Shade Ability
description: Your Haos Bakugan clears all Ability Card effects from a Bakugan with altered G's, returning it to base G's. (negating the Ability Cards it used in the chain)

name: Soul Binder
description: Nullify the Gate Card your Darkus Bakugan is standing on if you own it, then destroy one opposing Gate Card.

name: Spirit Canyon
description: Your Subterra Bakugan copies the effects of your opponent's G-altering Gate Card and applies them to a Bakugan on the field.

name: Storm Breaker
description: Nullify the Gate Card your Ventus Bakugan is standing on.

name: Subterra Triple Chain: Gaia Pressure
description: If you control three Subterra Bakugan on the field, all Gate Cards you control cannot be nullified, then all opposing Gate Cards on the field are converted into Subterra +100 Gate Cards, and their ownership is transferred to you.

name: Terra Crunch
description: Your Subterra Bakugan gain +50 G's for each Gate Card you control and 25 G's for each Gate Card your allies control.

name: Positive Triple Node
description: If your team has a Pyrus, Aquos, and Haos Bakugan on the field, they gain +200 G's.

name: Negative Triple Node
description: Darkus, Ventus, and Subterra Bakugan on the field, they gain +200 G's.

name: Ventus Triple Chain: Winds Of Fury
description: If you control three Ventus Bakugan on the field, one Ventus Bakugan you control makes an adjacent Bakugan (or one on the same Gate Card) lose -100 G's, then all your Ventus Bakugan can each attack one adjacent Bakugan.

name: Wall Burst
description: Reflect the last Ability Card if it targets your Pyrus Bakugan or alters the Gate Card it is standing on.

name: Water Refrain
description: Your Aquos Bakugan immediately negates all unactivated Ability Cards in the chain.

name: Water Slap
description: Your Aquos Bakugan subtracts -50 G's from an opposing Bakugan.

name: Abyss Ruler
description: Stinglash gains +100 G's.

name: Attractor
description: Pull an allied Bakugan to Centipoid's battle, or pull an opposing Bakugan to Centipoid's Gate Card.

name: Blessing of Comradery
description: Haos El Condor transfers and splits its G's between up to two allied Bakugan in hand or on the field; if an allied Bakugan returns to hand, El Condor regains the G's transferred; if only one Bakugan is selected, only half of its G's are transferred.

name: Blue Stealth
description: Preyas transfers 50 G's from an opposing Bakugan it is in battle with, then nullifies the Gate Card.

name: Boosted Dragon
description: Dragonoid permanently gains +100 G's.

name: Chaos Of The Darkness
description: Hydranoid attacks a Bakugan on the field, if that Bakugan has lower G's, it is defeated.

name: Crystal Fang
description: Tigrerra gains +80 G's.

name: Curse of Obsidian
description: Transfer 50 G's from a diagonal opposing Bakugan to Darkus El Condor; additionally, that Bakugan cannot gain G's until it returns to hand.

name: Cut In Saber
description: Immediately allows Tigrerra to enter the current battle.

name: Cut In Slayer
description: Tigrerra defeats allied Bakugan (hand/field/both) and transfers the G's to a chosen Bakugan.

name: Darkon Phaser
description: Darkus Griffon transfers 50 G's from one opposing Bakugan to an allied Bakugan.

name: Death Scythe
description: Reaper permanently subtracts -75 G's from an opposing Bakugan.

name: Depth Tornado
description: Juggernoid gains +100 G's.

name: Desert Thunder
description: Hynoid transfers 50 G's from an opponent.

name: Destruction Buster
description: Hydranoid nullifies the Gate Card it is standing on, then gains +100 G's.

name: Dragoon
description: Subterra El Condor gains G's equal to the current G's of an opposing Bakugan it is in battle with; otherwise, if the last played Ability Card targets El Condor, it gains G's equal to the current G's of that card's caster.

name: Fire Storm
description: Skyress gains +125 G's.

name: Gaia Breaker
description: Gorem destroys a Gate Card on the field.

name: Gaia Slammer
description: An opposing Bakugan is moved to a Gate Card adjacent to Subterra Griffon, then it loses -50 G's.

name: Gravity Chamber
description: Hydranoid pulls all adjecent opposing Bakugan with lower G's than itself to its Gate Card, then those Bakugan are defeated.

name: Green Aegis
description: Ventus Griffon gives all adjacent allies +50 G's, then all adjacent opponents lose -50 G's.

name: Hot Blast
description: El Condor nullifies the Gate Card it is currently on; then an opposing Bakugan in battle with it loses -50 G's.

name: Hydro Striver
description: Move an allied Bakugan to Aquos Griffon's Gate Card, then add +50 G's to the moved Bakugan.

name: Marionette
description: Mantris moves an opponent's Bakugan to another Gate Card.

name: Mega Impact
description: Gorem gains +50 G's then an opposing Bakugan in battle with it loses -100 G's.

name: Melt Flare
description: Dragonoid gains +175 G's, then it permanently keeps +50 G's of that gain.

name: Merge Shield
description: Hydranoid gains the same G's that are added to the opposing Bakugan it is in battle with.

name: Nose Slap
description: Tuskor attacks an adjacent Bakugan, if it is defeated, you may keep Tuskor on the field or return it to your hand.

name: Phoenix Burst
description: Pyrus El Condor gains G's equal to half of its current G's; if it wins a battle, it permanently gains +50 G's.

name: Poison Fang
description: Rattleoid transfers 50 G's from the opposing Bakugan it is battling, once Rattleoid is defeated, that Bakugan permanently loses -50 G's each time it is thrown out, while it remains on the field, it also loses -10 G's at the start of each of its turns.

name: Raging Tempest
description: Skyress swaps positions on the field with an opposing Bakugan, that Bakugan loses -85 G's.

name: Robotallion Enforcement
description: Robotallion permanently gains +50 G's, then it may choose up to two allied Bakugan to also permanently gain +50 G's. For each battle these Bakugan win, their permanent bonus increases by +25 G's. If Robotallion is defeated, all of these bonuses are removed.

name: Saurus Glow
description: Saurus permanently gains +50 G's.

name: Shining Saber
description: Tigrerra and all allied Bakugan gain +75 G's.

name: Slash Zero
description: Fear Ripper gains +80 G's.

name: Slice Cutter
description: Mantris subtracts 50 G's from an opposing Bakugan.

name: Sling Blazer
description: Mantris immediately moves an allied or opposing Bakugan in the battle with it to an adjacent Gate Card.

name: Solar Plexus
description: Ventus El Condor is immune to movement from all card effects; while it remains on the field, any opposing Bakugan that moves loses -75 G's, and any allied Bakugan that moves gains +75 G's.

name: Super Shard
description: Juggernoid subtracts -75 G's from an opposing Bakugan.

name: Totemic Tide
description: Aquos El Condor gains +75 G's; while El Condor remains on the field, each other allied Aquos gains +75 G's at the end of each of your turns.

name: Twin Machete
description: Mantris gains +100 G's.

name: Vanishing Finish
description: Preyas immediately gains +80 G's, and keeps 40 G's permanently.

name: Venomous Beast Torrent Attack
description: Automatically defeats your Haos Griffon in battle, then revive a defeated Bakugan you own and it gains +50 G's.

name: Vice Grip
description: If the last ability targets an allied Bakugan, Terrorclaw becomes the target instead.

name: Wing Burst
description: Transfer 50 G's from an opposing Bakugan to your Pyrus Griffon, then each other Pyrus Bakugan you control gain +25 G's.
